correctness.rationale: Eliminating the source fixed-shift two-stage GADI equations with alpha>0, 0<=omega<2, F positive stable, Q=C^T C and X0=0 gives exactly X_{k+1}=c X_k+b T X_k T^T+E E^T with c=omega/2, b=1-c>0, H=(alpha I+F)^-1, T=2alpha H^T-I, E=sqrt(2alpha b)H^T C^T. As identity and congruence operators commute, the binomial theorem yields X_k=sum_{j=0}^{k-1}w_{k,j}T^j E E^T(T^T)^j, w_{k,j}=b^j sum_{r=j}^{k-1}binom(r,j)c^{r-j}>0, giving exact PSD factor with kp columns. Its rank is the dimension of rational Krylov span, and diagonal distinct eigenvalues with p=1 yield rank min(k,n) by Vandermonde. Separate exact rational nonsymmetric 2x2 verification k=1..5 confirms both forms; infinite claim rests on algebraic identities.
